snippet.title: Asterika: Phantom Rose Refrain - 2025 Trailer!
snippet.description:
🎵Wishlist on Steam today!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3690850/Asterika_Phantom_Rose_Refrain

Dodge dangers to the beat in Asterika: Phantom Rose Refrain. Master grid-based movement and flow, adapting to shifting patterns. Follow the optional narrative of two girls and a magic-fueled city from the perspective of the "Engineer."
